The spending by the beverage giant will include new and expanded manufacturing and bottling plants, added distribution centers and warehouse capacity, office and campus facilities, and related production and delivery infrastructure

The $10B investment total includes both new and previously announced projects. Specific sites that will be upgraded include a bottling distribution facility in Rancho Cucamonga, California; a bottling plant in Colorado Springs, Colorado; a manufacturing plant in Indianapolis; a Coca-Cola United campus in Birmingham, Alabama; a Fairlife plant in Coopersville, Michigan; and a distribution center in Orlando.
